ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm each, orange-brown with darker caramelized edges and browned crusty surfaces, slightly glossy, firm and holding shape, clustered in the upper right of the plate | 75
ITEM 2 | Single strip of cooked meat, about 1 cm wide and 10 cm long, reddish-brown with pale streaks of fat, glossy and slightly curled, crisp-looking edges, lying diagonally on the right side of the plate | 15
ITEM 3 | Whole raspberries, bright red, matte with a bumpy drupelet surface, soft and rounded, about 2-2.5 cm each, roughly six pieces grouped in the center-left | 45
ITEM 4 | Blackberries, dark purple-black, glossy and bumpy with drupelets, about 2 cm each, roughly four pieces scattered near the raspberries | 30
ITEM 5 | Small fragment of light brown crumb or particle, about 0.5 cm, sitting on the plate near the top-left of the berries | 1
